spec.description:
Bradford Fire Protection - Filler (Fireseal Party Wall Batten
Fillers) are pre-cut, non-combustible rockwool insulation inserts designed to
seal hollow metal roof and ceiling battens crossing fire-rated separating walls
in Class 1 residential buildings. Manufactured from high-temperature rockwool,
these inserts fill the 40mm metal batten profile to prevent flame, hot gases,
and embers from bypassing the fire compartment boundary. They are purpose-shaped
to compress snugly inside steel batten profiles to meet NCC and BCA
Deemed-to-Satisfy requirements.
features:
Non-combustible stone wool
construction complying with AS 1530.1

Pre-cut to fit standard 40mm
residential metal roof and ceiling battens

Prevents fire spreading through
hollow steel batten cavities over party walls

High resistance to shrinkage
under extreme fire temperatures up to 1000°C

Quick and easy push-fit installation during roofing or ceiling
construction
Performance unaffected by contact with moisture or water
Purpose-designed for Class 1 multi-residential party wall junctions

technical.value: Standard 40 mm metal roof and ceiling battens

Ignitability: 0,
Spread of Flame: 0, Heat Evolved: 0, Smoke Developed: 0-1

spec.fire:
Non-combustible to AS 1530.1; Early Fire
Hazard indices to AS/NZS 1530.3: Ignitability 0, Spread of Flame 0, Heat
Evolved 0, Smoke Developed 0-1; Meets NCC Class 1 separating wall
Deemed-to-Satisfy fire provisions
spec.compliance:
NCC Volume Two / ABCB Housing
Provisions Part 9.3 (Separating walls fire protection), AS 1530.1
spec.sustainability:
Manufactured using natural rock and recycled slag;
bio-soluble FBS-1; zero ODP
install:
Locate metal roof or ceiling battens
crossing directly over the fire-rated party wall

Insert a Fireseal Batten
Filler into the open cavity of each continuous steel batten

Centre the filler
directly over the party wall line

Ensure the filler compresses firmly against
the inner faces of the steel batten profile

Check that no air gap or void
remains through the batten cross-section
selection_checklist:
Count total number of continuous
steel battens crossing the party wall line

Ensure sufficient boxes are
ordered (35 fillers per box)

Verify party wall system design and FRL
specifications
limitations:
Designed specifically
for hollow metal batten cavities; not for wide masonry gaps

Must be protected
from direct weather exposure prior to roof cladding installation

Cannot
substitute for party wall blanket or vertical joint batts
spec.warranty: Backed by CSR Bradford product warranty

problem_keywords: party wall roof junction fire rating

sealing steel battens
over party wall
use_cases:
Filling continuous 40mm steel roof battens crossing fire-rated
inter-tenancy walls in townhouses

Sealing ceiling battens at party wall
junctions in Class 1 multi-residential duplexes
retrieval.rag_summary:
Bradford Fire Protection - Filler (Fireseal Party
Wall Batten Fillers) are pre-formed non-combustible rockwool inserts
measuring 100mm x 40mm, designed specifically to plug continuous metal roof and
ceiling battens passing over party walls in Class 1 buildings. They prevent
fire, embers, and hot gases from channeling through hollow metal batten cavities
across inter-tenancy boundaries. Certified non-combustible to AS 1530.1 and
tested to AS/NZS 1530.3, they are a critical Deemed-to-Satisfy component of
compliant multi-residential passive fire containment systems.
